reference: 一期产品需求文档-技术对接.md (user-supplied September PRD, reviewed 2026-11-20)
scope: Six-module journal fields and four horizontal review cards; no new device integration, clinical inference or backend deployment.

sleep.derived: Merge overlapping recorded intervals; use longest daily segment for circular bedtime/wake spread with at least three days. No sleep-quality score on cards.

food.derived: Sum known energy/nutrients only; entries may contain estimates. No calorie target or diet-health score.

focus.derived: Only elapsedMs is actual duration. Start-time grouping requires genuine ISO startedAt and a non-self-reported timer. A completed timer does not complete the task.

sport.derived: Duration totals and explicitly selected intensity/recovery. Steps are manual. No inferred heart rate or energy burned.

mood.derived: Only explicit 1–10 self-rated intensity and selected causes; no sentiment-to-score conversion or good/bad ranking.

face.derived: Compare the two latest original self-observations; no inferred fatigue, emotion, beauty or health score.

compatibility: Old distanceKm folds into sport notes without duplicate distance
Legacy sleep ISO dates normalize to local HH:mm and preserve dates
Old timer snapshots without startedAt stay unknown
food/face coverage remains a separate data property and is not a score
No new required field or automatic rewriting of historical records
deploymentOrder: Review and authorize the additive public.valid_journal_fields function migration
Publish matching frontend. Old validator rejects new keys even when empty; do not publish frontend first.
verification: node scripts/verify-journal-review-deck.mjs with Chromium and WebKit
limitations: Browser WebKit is not physical iOS-device verification
No HealthKit, wearable, step sensor or clinical measurement was added
PRD sport specification tables are blank; optional fields use the shared data table without inventing mandatory requirements
